This looks promising! **Group 1: honey, spelling, busy, queen** (all can precede "bee")

**Potential Group 2 - Western/Cowboy related:**

Or **TV/Movie characters or shows:**

- Queen (movie/band?)
- Carter (Agent Carter? Lynda Carter?)

After reconsideration: **honey, spelling, busy, queen** (__ bee), **king, crunch, carter, cowboy** (all can follow "Captain"), **bridge, dip, tutu, squat** (ballet/exercise terms?), **bounty, gore, duel, saloon** (Western/action terms)
